coordinateConvention: PNG top-left; rect and surfaceRect=[x,y,w,h]; alpha_bbox and visibleBBox=[left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive; groundAnchor in untrimmed canvas; anchor normalized Cocos bottom-origin
cabinetNaming: counter_<direction> is DOOR facing direction, not wall location. North wall uses counter_south; south wall uses counter_north; west wall uses counter_east; east wall uses counter_west.
composition: Draw combined cabinets in increasing world Y, OR draw exposed body layers first then all square surface layers. Adjacent south tile hides the north tile body; do not draw body over a neighboring surface.
